component.name: Prism
component.summary: View local images with GPU rendering and broad format support

description.p: Prism is a local image viewer that renders image textures using WebGL2. Browse folders, pan, zoom, rotate, and play animated images.
View JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP images, with browser support for SVG, AVIF, and icons where available. Images stay on your device.
